headline: BI Predicts Rupiah Exchange Rate in 2027 at Rp 17.800-Rp 18.200/US$
summary: Bank Indonesia's governor said the central bank's 2027 policy mix aims to maintain stability and support growth. The central bank projects the rupiah at 17,800 to 18,200 per US dollar.
why: Bank Indonesia sets monetary policy for Southeast Asia's largest economy and manages the rupiah. Its currency forecasts guide expectations for inflation, rates and foreign investment.
original_headline: BI Prediksi Nilai Tukar Rupiah 2027 Rp 17.800-Rp 18.200/US$
